evidence.title: UNU-INWEH · Qeshm and Hengam oil interpretation
evidence.notes: UNU mapped oil near the islands from independently acquired Sentinel-1D imagery 39 minutes after the NISAR pass. The published chart provides regional evidence. Registration uncertainty is too high for pixel labels.

evidence.title: NOAA NESDIS · Eugene Island surveillance outline
evidence.notes: The public RADARSAT-2 interpretation at 12:10 UTC falls roughly 43 minutes after the NISAR pass. The report describes possible oil; material has not been validated per cell.

evidence.title: NOAA · Eloi Bay field report and surveillance
evidence.notes: NOAA records an independently confirmed crude discharge. The Landsat 8 outline at 16:26 UTC on October 12 is later imagery. This crop covers the coastal outline and nearby water. The later eastward outline extends past that local view.

evidence.title: Ramsar · Atanasovsko Lake
evidence.notes: Ramsar identifies the saline lagoon, marshes, reedbeds and managed salt pans. This single acquisition provides radar backscatter around them.
